name: ecr
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk AWS ECR (Elastic Container Registry) repository, provisioned within an environment and resource group.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this ECR repository.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: DuploCloud resource name for this repository. Distinct from repository_name (the AWS ECR name); use a simple identifier here. Cannot be changed after creation.

attributes.name: repository_name
attributes.description: Name of the AWS ECR repository (may contain path separators, e.g. "team/backend"). Immutable — AWS has no rename API.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment in which the repository is provisioned.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group in which the repository is provisioned.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs linking this repository to a cloud provider account. Derived from the resource group; not user-settable.

attributes.name: encryption
attributes.description: Server-side encryption for the repository: NoEncryption / AwsManagedKey (AWS-managed AES256) / ResourceGroupKmsKey (the resource group's KMS key). ResourceGroupKmsKey requires the resource group to have a provisioned KMS key. Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: scan_on_push
attributes.description: Scan images for vulnerabilities automatically when pushed. Can be changed in place.

attributes.name: image_tag_mutability
attributes.description: Whether image tags can be overwritten: MUTABLE (tags may be overwritten) or IMMUTABLE (tags are write-once). Can be changed in place.

attributes.name: tags
key
attributes.description: Tag key.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Tag value.
Tags applied to the repository at creation, as a list of key/value pairs. Platform ownership tags are added automatically.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type. Defaults to DirectApiCall for ECR.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status of the repository.

attributes.name: ecr_id
attributes.description: ID of this ECR repository resource, for reference by dependent resources.

attributes.name: repository_arn
attributes.description: ARN of the provisioned ECR repository.

attributes.name: repository_uri
attributes.description: URI of the repository (used as the image push/pull target).

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: AWS account ID of the registry that hosts the repository.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the repository was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the repository was last updated (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version counter, incremented on each update.
